relations.rationale: A directly asserts the opposite of B.
Zeno being lead volunteer has no bearing on Jun's conversation with an official.
Zeno's role as lead volunteer is unrelated to whether Milo and Jun share a team.
Zeno's leadership role has no connection to Milo and Hana's team membership.
Zeno being lead volunteer doesn't affect Isla's past race ranking.
Zeno's volunteer status is unrelated to the weather at the starting horn.
Riders gathering in fog has nothing to do with Zeno's age relative to Isla.
Riders gathering near the starting banners naturally precedes and supports the group moving together to the starting line.
Fog lifting during gathering has no bearing on Milo's height compared to others.
The gathering scene is unrelated to Hana's past event ranking.
The gathering scene is unrelated to Isla's past event ranking.
Fog still lifting suggests the sun had not yet fully broken through, contradicting sun breaking through at the horn if these are simultaneous, but since horn timing could be later, this is weak.
Hana's arrival time relative to Milo is unrelated to her laughing at Zeno's joke.
Checking tire pressure is unrelated to laughing at a weather comment.
Hana's tire-checking has no bearing on Milo's height.
Hana checking her tire pressure is unrelated to Isla checking her watch.
Isla bringing the first-aid kit doesn't relate to how ready she and Zeno looked for the climb.
Isla bringing a first-aid kit is unrelated to Hana laughing at Zeno's joke.
Isla's first-aid kit has no connection to Milo's height among cyclists.
Isla bringing the first-aid kit is unrelated to Jun finishing stretching.
